Pre-shampoo oil

Ends serum

Butter for curly hair

How we work

Four rules that do not change

01Few ingredients

If an ingredient is not needed, it is not there. The list is on the label.

02Small batches

We make a little at a time, so products stay fresh.

03Test first

Every product should be tried first on a small patch of skin.

04No miracles

Making hair softer is realistic. For the rest, we tell it as it is.

How to use them

Three simple habits

01Do a patch test

A small amount on your forearm, then wait 24 hours.

02Start small

Better to add than remove: fine hair weighs down quickly.

03Listen to your hair

If your scalp gets irritated, stop. If in doubt, ask a professional.
